Northwind TW-200 torque wrench specification

The Northwind TW-200 is a click-type torque wrench that covers 20 to 210 newton metres and costs ₹4,999. It is supplied with a calibration certificate recording the measured deviation at 20 percent, 60 percent and 100 percent of full scale.

Measured specification

Stated accuracy is plus or minus three percent of the set value in the clockwise direction across the whole range. The scale is marked in newton metres and in pound feet. The mechanism releases with an audible click and a short break in the handle that can be felt through a glove. Overall length is 470 millimetres and the drive is a 12.7 millimetre square with a push-through ratchet.

Maintenance

We recommend recalibration every twelve months, or after five thousand cycles, whichever comes first. Store the wrench wound down to its lowest setting so the spring is not held under load between uses.

The price list covers the calibration fee, the selection guide compares the TW-200 with the smaller TW-050, and the company page describes the calibration laboratory.

Specification last checked 9 August 2026.
